en.title: Echoes of the Neuro Library: Judgment of the Apocrypha Sleeping in Cyber Ash
en.premise: In a highly managed information society where physical recording media are strictly forbidden, an "underground library" is discovered. It is a mad sanctuary where taboo data, having escaped corporate censorship, is preserved in the form of paper books. On the night of a festival, the library's administrator meets a mysterious death caused by a "logical contradiction." Relying on fragmented logs left inside the dead man's brain and unnaturally high-purity silver particles found at the scene, a detective initiates a ruthless game over the authenticity of information.

zh.title: 神经图书馆的残响 ——长眠于赛博灰烬中的伪典审判——
zh.premise: 在一个高度信息管理社会中，人们发现了被禁止拥有物理记录媒介的“地下图书馆”。那里是一处疯狂的圣域，逃过企业审查的禁忌数据以纸质书籍的形式被保存下来。在庆典之夜，该图书馆的管理者迎来了因“逻辑矛盾”而亡的离奇死亡。侦探依靠死者脑海中残留的碎片化日志，以及现场掉落的纯度高得不自然的银粒子，拉开了围绕信息真实性的冷酷游戏之幕。
